The athlete gave a calendar date, 11/1/26, which is November 1, 2026. Today is 2026-11-17, so that date has already passed. Per the rules, a date without a year means the next occurrence, but here the year is explicit, so it is in the past. I should not guess a future race from it. The right move is to say so and ask again, rather than emit a raceDate that would build a block backwards from a past race.

{"route": "patch", "say": "11/1/26 has already gone by, and we're on 17 November now. Is the race next year, or is it a different date coming up?"}
